rationale: The assistant matched the hidden truth closely: it correctly separated imbalance/foreign object from bearings, had the customer unplug and check drum rumble and play by hand, and concluded 'very likely worn drum bearings' with appropriately hedged language. It flagged that 'on many machines the outer tub is sealed', advised against high-speed use, and directed the customer to an engineer quote weighed against replacement at nine years - exactly the expected direction with no part recommended. Minor deductions for repeating the corner-rocking check across two turns and for never asking for the make/model (which would have let it confirm the sealed-tub point for this specific Zanussi), though the model was never offered by the customer.
